description: Urban Development Authority - Notice of approval of the Development Plan for the Urban Development Area of Part of the Maho Pradeshiya Sabha Area
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land and property-related matters, specifically the approval of a development plan for an urban development area within the Maho Pradeshiya Sabha limits. The content focuses on land use planning, zoning changes, and urban development regulations under the Urban Development Authority Law, which falls squarely within the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4). While it mentions Minister Mahinda Rajapaksa, it does not involve government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities that would trigger a government-related classification.
